FX-PGRID-001.says: The settings as added, at frames 0 and 12: a grid 41 by 31 points, 20 pixels apart, so only its middle point lands on this 16 by 10 layer, a white soft dot 4 pixels across in the middle; still; the layer's own picture is gone.

FX-PGRID-002.says: A small grid: 4 by 2 white dots, 2 pixels across.

FX-PGRID-003.says: A finer grid: 5 by 3 dots 1.5 pixels across, 3 pixels apart.

FX-PGRID-004.says: Sphere Feather 0 on big dots: hard edges.

FX-PGRID-005.says: Glow Spheres on the big dots: solid cores and faint glows.

FX-PGRID-006.says: Stars: 2 by 1 points, 6 pixels across, five points up.

FX-PGRID-007.says: Cloudlets on the big dots: soft to the edge.

FX-PGRID-008.says: Size 1 on the small grid: drawn 1.4 pixels across, fainter by the true size.

FX-PGRID-009.says: Size Random 80 on the fine grid: each dot its own size.

FX-PGRID-011.says: Opacity Random 80 on the fine grid: each dot its own opacity.

FX-PGRID-013.says: Big overlapping blue dots, Normal: later points over earlier.

FX-PGRID-014.says: The same, Add: brighter where they overlap.

FX-PGRID-016.says: The fine grid turned 30 degrees about Z.

FX-PGRID-017.says: The fine grid turned 60 degrees about Y: narrower, the right side farther and smaller.

FX-PGRID-018.says: The deep grid tipped 50 degrees about X: its three layers seen from above.

FX-PGRID-019.says: The deep grid straight on: the far layers smaller and drawn nearer the middle, the front layer over them.

FX-PGRID-020.says: The small grid moved up and left, and 10 pixels back.

FX-PGRID-021.says: Sphere Layered: one shell, 8 points round on 5 rings, 8 pixels across.

FX-PGRID-022.says: Two shells: an inner ball half the size inside.

FX-PGRID-023.says: The ball turning: Form Rotation Y keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 80 at frame 24, at frames 0, 12 and 24.

FX-PGRID-024.says: Disperse 1.5: each dot nudged its own way, the grid loosened.

FX-PGRID-026.says: Twist 120: the top row turned one way about the up line, the bottom row the other, so the rows narrow and widen.

FX-PGRID-027.says: Fractal displace 2 at scale 6: the grid rippled.

FX-PGRID-028.says: The ripple drifting: Flow X 12 pixels a second, at frames 0, 12 and 24; the field slides through the grid.

FX-PGRID-029.says: The ripple changing: Flow Evolution 1 a second, at frames 0 and 12.

FX-PGRID-031.says: Affect Size 150 with no displacement: the field grows and shrinks the dots in place.

FX-PGRID-032.says: Affect Opacity 100: the field fades dots in place.

FX-PGRID-033.says: Flow Y keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 24 at frame 24: the drift speeds up, by frame 24 moved 12 pixels' worth, at frames 12 and 24.

FX-PGRID-034.says: Color Map the ramp: the dots red to the right, green lower down.

FX-PGRID-035.says: Color Map half blue, half clear: only the left half's dots, blue.

FX-PGRID-036.says: Size Map the spot: big dots in the middle, none at the edges.

FX-PGRID-037.says: Displace Map the spot, Map Displace 6: the middle pushed towards the camera, larger and spread out.

FX-PGRID-038.says: Map Displace -6: the middle pushed away, smaller and drawn in.

FX-PGRID-039.says: All three maps at once on the tipped grid.

FX-PGRID-040.says: The deep grid through a composition camera 12 pixels in front: the far layers much smaller, the near ones larger.

FX-PGRID-041.says: FX-PGRID-028 with the layer starting at frame 10: frame 10 as its frame 0, frame 22 as its frame 12.

FX-PGRID-042.says: FX-PGRID-027 with the layer moved 3 pixels right.

FX-PGRID-043.says: FX-PGRID-027 with Random Seed 7: a different ripple.

FX-PGRID-044.says: Particles In X keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 24, whole points only: 3 across at frame 9, 5 at frame 21.

FX-PGRID-047.says: Form Size 0: all eight dots on one spot in the middle, piled up.

FX-PGRID-048.says: One point: a single dot in the middle.

FX-PGRID-049.says: A glowing grid coloured by the ramp, rippling and added.
